security.title: Two-Factor Authentication
security.description: When enabled, you will need a code from your authenticator app in addition to your password to log in.
security.disableConfirm: Codes will no longer be required when logging in. Disable two-factor authentication?
security.setupScan: 1. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), or enter the secret key manually.
security.setupCode: 2. Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app to finish.
security.recoveryCodesTip: Store these recovery codes in a safe place. They can be used to log in if you cannot use your authenticator app. Each code can be used only once.
security.recoveryCodesRegenerated: Recovery codes regenerated. The old codes no longer work.
